start.title: Choose your loadout
start.note: The horde never stops growing: last as long as you can. New weapons come at levels {levels}. A weapon grows to level {max} through level-up cards, then evolves one of two ways, and two evolved weapons of a pair can merge into a stronger one.
start.saved: A saved run is waiting. Starting a new one drops it.
hints: [WASD] or arrows, or drag on the field, to walk · [Space] active skill · [1]–[4] pick a card · [R] reroll the cards · [X] skip a level-up · [P] pause

An orange outline is armor that blunts physical damage, a violet outline is a ward that blunts magic: 100 of either halves a hit, and damage never vanishes. A double outline is a tank: hit it with the other kind, set it on fire, or pierce its armor. Pure damage ignores both.
Enemies with a dot in the middle fight from a distance. Everything the horde throws at you is bright cyan: shots, and dashed outlines on the ground for strikes about to land. Step out of them.
Red orbs heal. Walking turns them up, and elites drop them along with a chest: pick 1 item of {chestSlots}. A blue chest is better than a grey one, a yellow one better still.
A blue horseshoe is a magnet: it pulls in every XP orb on the map.

cards.chestNote: Pick one. Every item is one of a kind.
cards.evolveNote: It is at its last level. Pick the way it changes for good.
cards.weaponNote: Pick one to add to your kit.
cards.countRemark: Shot {shot} of {cap} from cards. Items and weapon levels add more
cards.weakPick: Weak pick: the {strong} strong ones are taken
cards.critRemark: Past 100% a crit can land twice
cards.mergeNote: Both weapons go, and the merged one takes their place.
cards.evoMerges: Leads to {merge}, with {partner} evolved either way.
cards.merges: Merges {list} once both are at Lv {max} and evolved.

settings.title: Settings
settings.attackAlphaNote: Make your own attacks see-through to keep the horde and its shots in sight. At 100% they look as usual.
settings.devNote: Opens the developer panel: F1, or the button in the pause menu. A run where a cheat was used goes to no records and earns no Glory.

dev.title: Developer panel
dev.note: Seed {seed}. Every button but those under Show marks the run: no records, no Glory.
dev.keys: Dev keys: [F1] panel · [L] level up · [G] weapon pick · [I] open a chest · [K] die and revive · [R] reset active · [T] skip a minute · [E] elite · [F] shooters · [O] fill the horde · [H] immortal · [M] max a weapon

end.title: Run ended
end.cheated: Developer cheats were used: this run goes to no records and earns no Glory.

records.title: Records
records.none: No runs in {version} yet. Runs are compared only within one balance version; the {count} longest are listed here.

camp.title: Camp
camp.note: Every run earns Glory: for the minutes you last, elites killed, levels and merges. Upgrades bought here stay for every run. You have {glory} Glory.

rerolls.name: Rerolls
rerolls.text: +{amount, plural, one {# reroll} other {# rerolls}} for the run

revival.name: Revival
revival.text: +{amount, plural, one {# spare life} other {# spare lives}}

codex.title: Codex
codex.mergeRule: Once both weapons are at Lv {max} and evolved, a card offers the merge. Where an evolution is named under a weapon, only that one opens the merge. A weapon goes into one merge only.
codex.keeps: It keeps what the evolutions did
codex.itemAdds: Adds to {stats} at full value, on top of the cards.
codex.itemUnique: Every item is one of a kind: a chest never offers one you have.
codex.weaponsNote: Press a weapon to see its levels, evolutions and merges.
codex.mergesNote: Two weapons at their last level, both evolved, merge into one; where an evolution is named under a weapon, only that one will do. A merge of two weapons of one kind keeps that kind.
codex.itemsNote: Items come from chests: elites drop one, pick 1 item of {chestSlots}. Press an item for more.
codex.statsNote: The first {strong} picks of a stat are strong, every pick after them is weaker. Items and Camp upgrades always add their full value on top. A weapon gets a stat only if it uses it.
codex.statForWeapons: For the weapons that use it.
codex.countLine: +1 shot per pick. The card stops coming at +{cap}; items, the Camp and weapon levels add more shots with no limit. A weapon that fires a single shot gets +{overflow}% damage per Count instead.
codex.statLine: Strong pick: {strong}. Weak pick: {weak}. Starts at {base}.

statExtra.critChance: Every weapon can crit. Past 100% a crit can land twice.
statExtra.armor: A hit does 100 / (100 + Armor) of its damage. Bastion hits harder with it.
statExtra.vitality: Summoned copies get your max health, and hit harder the more you have.
statExtra.haste: A weapon attacks 1 + Haste times as often.

armorLines: Armor blunts physical hits and ward blunts magic ones: a hit does 100 / (100 + armor) of its damage, so 100 halves it and damage never vanishes. A hybrid hit meets the average of the two.
Penetration lowers armor (physical) or ward (magic) before a hit; past zero the hit does more, up to twice. Railgun and Frost Halo take armor or ward off enemies, never more than half.
Burning also takes {burn}% of an enemy's max health per second for every stack, half on elites.
Tanks come from minute {tanksFrom}: Iron Tanks need magic, Ward Tanks need physical damage, and the Colossus has a lot of health.
codex.activesNote: Every active skill brings a weapon of its own for free, from the start and on top of the one you pick. That weapon cannot be your first one then.
codex.abilityHaste: Ability Haste shortens the active skill's cooldown: 100 / (100 + Ability Haste) of it is left, so 50 leaves two thirds of it and it never reaches zero. Only items give it. Weapons do not read it, and Haste does not touch the active skill.
codex.ownWeapon: The own weapon of {active}: marked whenever it is offered.

blackfrost.name: Black Frost

What an arrow kills bursts into {shards, plural, one {# piercing shard} other {# piercing shards}}. Count adds {perCount, plural, one {# arrow} other {# arrows}}.

mirrorshield.name: Mirror Shield
mirrorshield.blurb: Stores up to {charges, plural, one {# charge} other {# charges}}: a charge blocks one hit, blasts everything nearby and sends the hit back, turning the beam all the way round you. Every few seconds a wide beam sweeps a {sweep}° arc across the nearest enemy, burns the enemy shots it crosses and takes {shredArmor}% of the armor off every enemy it passes for {shredTime} s, more with every pass, up to half of it, so all your physical damage hits harder. Enemies that touch you get hurt. Count adds beams.
